d:
Planning a trip to Mauritius from India and wondering which is a great place to stay?
In this Mauritius travel vlog, we share our complete day experience in Mauritius, from breakfast at the resort to beach time, local food, coral reef boat tour, sugarcane museum visit, sunset plans, and our final moments before leaving the island.
This is not a scripted travel guide. This is a real, relaxed, and honest Mauritius island experience as an Indian couple.
In this video, you will see:
• Resort breakfast and morning island vibe
• Boat tour and coral reef experience
• Beach time and Indian Ocean views
